label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink value is encodeForHTML(fileName) written to HTML response; HTML encoding prevents script execution. Alert 2 (java/path-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is TESTFILES_DIR + bar where bar = decoded header name; attacker can supply header names with path traversal sequences (../) to access files outside TESTFILES_DIR. Alert 3 (java/error-message-exposure): alert-TP — resolved sink value is e.getMessage() exposed to client; exposes internal error information. Case TP: at least one alert-TP (alerts 2 and 3).

evidence.note: Path injection sink: new File(fileName) where fileName = TESTFILES_DIR + bar, bar derived from user header name
XSS sink: encodeForHTML(fileName) applied to response writer; encoding mitigates XSS
Error message exposure: e.getMessage() printed to response writer exposing internal errors
